rows.Synonyms:
• Crazy for You

• Hanabi
• WEKroalt
rows.ARS:
Red blend Large-Flowered Climber.
Registration name: WEKroalt
Exhibition name: Fourth of July
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, 1999).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 1999 as 'Fourth of July'.
Introduced in Australia by Swane's Nursery/Swane Bros Pty Ltd in 2000 as 'Climbing Fourth Of July'.
rows.Bloom: Red blend, stripes. Apple, rose fragrance. Average diameter 2". Large, semi-double (9-16 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Climbing.

Height: 43" to 15' (110 to 455cm). Width: 26" to 6' (65 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6a through 9b. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Patents:

rows.Parentage:
Roller Coaster (cl. miniature, McGredy, 1980) ×
Altissimo (Large-flowered Climber, Delbard-Chabert, 1966)
rows.Notes:
Known as the climber, 'Fourth of July' in America, and 'Crazy For You', the Cluster-flowered/Floribunda in the UK.
WEKroalt is one of the new varieties that was added to the RINZ Rose Display Trial at the Auckland Regional Botanic Gardens in 1999.
